description.text: Improving Access to Small Business Information Act

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

bill.title: Improving Access to Small Business Information Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill exempts actions by the Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation from being a "collection of information" under the Paperwork Reduction Act. It amends Section 4(i) of the Securities Exchange Act, preserves some PRA review duties, but exempts the SEC from OMB submission, control-number display, and clearance labeling.

impact.summary: The bill exempts the SEC's Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation from being a "collection of information" under the Paperwork Reduction Act. It removes OMB submission and control-number requirements and affects the SEC, OMB, small issuers, startups, and others who work with the Advocate.
